documents.title: Return Policy
documents.content: We accept returns within 30 days of purchase with original receipt. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days to the original payment method. Items must be unused and in original packaging.

documents.title: Shipping Policy
documents.content: Free standard shipping on orders over $50. Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days. Express shipping available for $15 with 1-2 day delivery. International shipping rates vary by country.

documents.title: Warranty Policy
documents.content: All products include a 12-month manufacturer warranty covering defects in materials and workmanship. Warranty does not cover accidental damage, misuse, or normal wear and tear. Extended warranties available for purchase.

documents.title: How do I track my order?
documents.content: You can track your order using the tracking number sent to your email. Simply click the tracking link or visit our website and enter your order number in the tracking section. Updates are provided in real-time.

documents.title: What payment methods do you accept?
documents.content: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover), PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. Payment is processed securely through our encrypted checkout system.
